system.name: HydraServe
system.one_liner: a serverless LLM serving system that minimizes cold-start latency in public clouds

components.name: Resource Allocation Algorithm (§4.1)
components.role: allocates resources for each cold-start model based on user SLOs

components.name: Network-Contention-Aware Worker Placement (§4.2)
components.role: places pipeline workers to avoid network contention that could cause SLO violations

components.name: Partition
components.role: splits the model into parts assigned to workers/nodes

components.name: Worker 0
components.role: a pipeline worker assigned to a node by the placement strategy

components.name: Worker 1
components.role: a pipeline worker assigned to a node by the placement strategy

components.name: Node 0
components.role: a GPU server node hosting a placed worker

components.name: Node 1
components.role: a GPU server node hosting a placed worker

components.name: Model Prefetcher (§5)
components.role: proactively fetches model weights for cold-start workers, overlapping fetching with container creation and runtime init

components.name: Parameter Manager (§5)
components.role: loads parameters to the GPU in parallel with library loading

components.name: GPU 0
components.role: GPU used by Worker 0 to load and run the model

components.name: GPU 1
components.role: GPU used by Worker 1 to load and run the model

components.name: Pipeline Consolidation (§6)
components.role: consolidates pipeline workers into a standalone worker hosting all parameters

components.name: New Worker
components.role: the consolidated standalone worker resulting from merging pipeline workers

components.name: KV Cache Migration
components.role: migrates KV cache state as a worker is terminated during consolidation

components.name: Terminate
components.role: shuts down a pipeline worker after its state is migrated/consolidated

flows.what: pipeline consolidation into a standalone worker

content.key_idea: HydraServe organizes cold-start optimization into three hierarchical levels: cluster-level SLO-aware resource allocation and contention-aware placement, worker-level overlapped model prefetching and parallel parameter loading, and inference-level consolidation of pipeline workers into standalone workers.
content.reading_order: Top-down and left-right across three labeled quadrants: Cluster Level (top-left, allocation and placement), Worker Level (right, prefetching and parameter loading onto GPUs), and Inference Level (bottom-left, pipeline consolidation and KV cache migration).

evidence: As shown in Figure 3, HydraServe adopts a three-level hierarchical architecture
At the cluster level, the central controller employs a resource allocation algorithm (§4.1) and a network-contention-aware worker placement strategy (§4.2)
HydraServe consolidates pipeline workers into standalone workers that host all parameters (§6)

summary: This figure gives the system overview of HydraServe, a serverless LLM serving system for minimizing cold-start latency, organized into a three-level hierarchical architecture. The Cluster Level (top-left) shows a Resource Allocation Algorithm partitioning work per user SLO and a Network-Contention-Aware Worker Placement strategy assigning Worker 0 and Worker 1 to Node 0 and Node 1. The Worker Level (right) shows a Model Prefetcher overlapping model-weight fetching with container/runtime initialization, and per-worker Parameter Managers loading parameters onto GPU 0 and GPU 1 in parallel with library loading. The Inference Level (bottom-left) shows Pipeline Consolidation, where Worker 1 migrates its KV cache to Worker 0, which becomes a New Worker hosting the entire model, while Worker 1 is terminated. Each of the three levels is drawn as a separate dashed panel, with color-coded boxes (blue for workers/placement, salmon for the prefetcher, orange for the parameter manager, green for nodes) tying the visual layout directly to the paper's three-level design.
summary_zh: 该图展示 HydraServe 的三层架构总览：集群层（资源分配算法与网络争用感知的工作节点放置）、工作节点层（模型预取器与参数管理器并行加载 GPU 参数）、推理层（流水线整合，KV 缓存从 Worker 1 迁移到 Worker 0 并终止 Worker 1，形成独立完整的新 Worker）。
